source_construct: operator lookup by id outside the operator
target_translation: `get_operator_kit(extra.op_id_)` (kit store indexed by spec index, ob_exec_context.h:166-185) becomes a lookup in ObExecContext's SpecId-indexed SPF-iterator table (RULEBOOK 0.6; api/07 §6 ex.14) keyed by `SpecId::from_index(extra.op_id_ as u32)`: the subquery iterators move out of ObSubPlanFilterOp::subplan_iters_ into that table and hold no operator pointer (ObSubQueryIterator::op_ / parent_ ob_subplan_filter_op.h:126,138 are their own rows). The out-param `ObSubQueryIterator *&iter` becomes the table key `(SpecId, iter_idx_)`; the callers (ob_expr_subquery_ref.cpp:216,338; ob_expr_in.cpp:1560; ob_expr_operator.cpp:3343,3425) drive the iterator inside `ctx.with_exec_ctx(|exec| ..)`. Checks and codes unchanged: !extra.is_valid() -> OB_INVALID_ARGUMENT; no entry or spec type != PHY_SUBPLAN_FILTER -> OB_ERR_UNEXPECTED; iter_idx_ >= count -> OB_ARRAY_OUT_OF_RANGE.
